name: Avinarc
description:
A hood pulled off a dark-cloaked stranger in the back corner of a tavern
may reveal an Avinarc, with its hawk-like head and its feather-covered skin.
The Avinarc’s once-powerful wings have become arms with dexterous hands.
Only their heads and their feathers give them away as a non-human.
With a cloak covering them, their form is that of a lightly-built human.

racial_talents.name: Acute Smell
racial_talents.description: Avinarcs gain a +10 bonus on Perception rolls involving smell.

racial_talents.name: Light-boned
racial_talents.description:
Avinarcs are treated as Small creatures for purposes of their hits (determine
normally, then multiply by 0.75) and attacks against them, but not for other purposes.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Avinarcs may attack using their beaks, using the Beak specialization of Combat
Training: Unarmed skill

racial_talents.name: Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Avinarcs are carnivores and gain no sustenance from foods other than meat.

racial_talents.name: Sight, Eagle
racial_talents.description:
Avinarc’s keen eyesight permits both good peripheral vision as well as the ability to
focus on distant objects, such as a hare two miles away. They gain a +20 bonus to all
vision based Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Wings, Vestigial
racial_talents.description:
Avinarc wings (now reduced to heavily feathered arms) are too small for flight,
but provide a +10 bonus to Jumping and when using Acrobatics to reduce the impact
of a fall.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Avinarc are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Dwarf
description:
Probably the “toughest” physically of the races, Dwarves are short, stocky,
and ruddy of complexion, with deep-set eyes and dark wiry hair and beards
(the latter they are quite proud of, growing long elaborate braids).
Dwarves are superior craftsmen and well adapted to life underground; they
love to mine the earth for metals and precious gems, crafting them into
powerful weapons and artifacts. Not as fertile as humans, they have few
children, and less than a third of their people are women, who are guarded
jealously within their cavernous halls.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Dwarves can see 10' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Dwarves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Inept
racial_talents.description:
Due to their density, dwarves must work especially hard
to keep from drowning. They suffer a -25 penalty
on Endurance rolls while swimming.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Dwarves recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Dwarves are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Elf, fair
description:
The most lordly of all Elves, Fair Elves have golden hair, blue eyes,
pale skin, and prefer garments of white, silver, and gold. Whether it
is derived from divine favor or fey heritage, they have a visible aura
which awes allies and intimidates foes. They are seldom seen beyond the
borders of the elven lands, where they inspire their kin with their music,
magic, and wisdom. Melody and song frequent their gatherings, because
even the least of them can play the harp or sing, while the more talented
compose music or delight the ear with expertise on several instruments.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description:
Elves meditate rather than sleeping. Two hours of meditation replaces four
hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Immune to Disease
racial_talents.description: Fair Elves are immune to all non-magical disease.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Fair Elves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Defensive Aura
racial_talents.description:
The aura of Fair Elves dulls or confuses the senses of their foes, granting them
+10 DB, which is not cumulative with any Aura or Blur spell.

racial_talents.name: Golden Throat
racial_talents.description:
Fair Elves have beautiful voices which soothe and calm. They receive +10 to any
maneuver to verbally calm or persuade (Charm, Singing, Leadership, etc.).

racial_talents.name: Slow Healer
racial_talents.description: Fair Elves recover slower than normal. Recovery times are doubled.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Fair Elves are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Elf, grey
description:
Grey elves are almost always intermediate between their more extreme
brethren. Most have fair hair and blue or grey eyes. They are neither
as artistic as the fair elves, as cunning and warlike as the high elves,
or as sedate and rustic as the wood elves. They form the middle ground
with their pleasant company and their love of art and craft. When war
calls, they will take up arms, but mostly they will settle down, raise
a family and do as they please. They build no marble cities, but love
open cities amongst a lovely landscape which connects them closer to
nature. Some live under the rule of High Elves, while others take to
the seas as merchants and travelers. They are not the most magical elves,
but they are no strangers to magic either.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description:
Grey Elves meditate rather than sleeping. Two hours of meditation replaces four
hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Immune to Disease
racial_talents.description: Grey Elves are immune to all non-magical disease.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Grey Elves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Slow Healer
racial_talents.description: Grey Elves recover slower than normal. Recovery times are doubled.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Grey Elves are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Elf, high
description:
Raven-black hair distinguishes the High Elves from their fairer kindred,
and brown and hazel are their usual eye colors. A love of beautiful
things, expressed by skill in building and crafting, unites with a
curiosity about the nature of all creation to lure the most ambitious
from the path of nature. Yet, the superb armor, the bright weapons, and
the lovely jewelry cherished within their graceful, marble-walled cities
seem almost worth the price. Some of the most powerful artifacts known
to exist come from the forges of these elven craftsmen. When they live
among other elves, they take inspiration from the Fair Elves but willingly
accept the day-to-day burden of ruling their kin.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description:
High Elves meditate rather than sleeping. Two hours of meditation replaces four
hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Immune to Disease
racial_talents.description: High Elves are immune to all non-magical disease.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
High Elves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Slow Healer
racial_talents.description: High Elves recover slower than normal. Recovery times are doubled.

name: Elf, wood
description:
Wood Elves wear greens and greys to blend with their surroundings.
Sandy hair and light blue, green, or grey eyes complement their
rustic demeanor. They are slightly shorter than other elves, though
taller than humans. These Elves are the most common of all elvenkind
and can be found in almost any forest across the world. Wood Elves
are often quite distant from other elves and have been known to disagree
openly with the policies of the High Elves and Fair Elves. Most attuned
to the subtle tides of forests, streams, and the creatures who roam
the sylvan realm, Wood Elves are adept at moving silently, their presence
in the wood frequently going unnoticed among the shadows of swaying branches.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description:
Wood Elves meditate rather than sleeping. Two hours of meditation replaces four
hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Immune to Disease
racial_talents.description: Wood Elves are immune to all non-magical disease.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Wood Elves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Cat
racial_talents.description:
Wood Elves have hearing as keen as a cat, allowing them to hear some high-pitched
sounds and more accurately determine the location of a sound’s source (gaining
+10 on Perception maneuvers to locate a sound).

racial_talents.name: Slow Healer
racial_talents.description: Wood Elves recover slower than normal. Recovery times are doubled.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Wood Elves are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Gnoll
description:
Small wrinkled figures with grey skin and little hair, Gnolls inhabit
the natural caverns that abound in mountainous regions, while making
use of aboveground resources. When sheltered by secrecy and stone, their
timid dispositions relax and permit the enjoyment of gleeful festivals.
On these occasions, Gnolls put aside their sober, earth-toned clothing
for more colorful garb. Sunlight does not harm them, but the brightness
scares them and makes their eyes water (-25 to all activities), leading
Gnolls to favor the underground realm. It is reputed that they travel
extensively to the elemental realm of earth using secret portals, and
that their animal familiars have more than a touch of elemental nature.
Skill as illusionists, dabblers and magicians (but almost never any realm
but Essence) enables them to avoid encounters with other races, few
gaining knowledge of their presence until after the Gnolls have passed
from the area. They travel in clans and settle only in deserted grottos
where access is limited and concealed, and do not remain in any one
location for longer than a few years, in order to minimize the
accumulating signs of their presence.

racial_talents.name: Decreased Size
racial_talents.description:
Gnolls are Small creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 0.75.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Gnolls can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Gnolls suffer a -25 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight, but no
penalty on cloudy days or in shaded areas.

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Hare
racial_talents.description:
Gnolls have keen hearing in the high and low frequency range. They can localize
sounds with great accuracy and hear danger coming from 10 times farther than a
human. They gain +20 on hearing Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Prodigy
racial_talents.description:
Gnolls are closely attuned to their environment, and especially alert to shifts in
weather, which they use to conceal their movements. They receive +10 on Survival maneuvers,
doubled when using the skill for weather watching.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Gnolls recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Gnolls are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Gnome
description:
Smaller than dwarves, and appearing more frail and withered in build,
long-lived Gnomes prefer to live in shallow caves where they obsessively
gather knowledge and lore. Ancient tomes and rare scrolls litter their
crowded libraries, precious chambers that usually fall to ruin with a
Gnome’s death. A love of solitude ensures that most Gnomes remain
heirless, rarely marrying or raising a family despite typical life
spans of 600 years. Gnomes keep to themselves, but if forced into
combat their foes had better be prepared for a surprise, for there is
no telling what magical spells and/or artifacts any given Gnome will
have. Although loners, Gnomes are neither shy nor joyless; generous
hospitality accompanied by ingenious entertainments draws many friends
to visit as houseguests. Gnomes do not often return these visits, for
they dislike abandoning their abodes and the treasures guarded within
for even a few days. Those who do often create elaborate systems of
traps (many of them magical in nature). Those who do marry may combine
their resources, if they can agree as to how the collections should be
sorted. Gnomish children are raised on a steady diet of lore, both
entertaining and educational.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Gnomes can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

name: Goblin
description:
Goblins are small, about 3’ tall, with thin, wiry builds. They tend
toward long, narrow heads with pointy chins, pointed ears without lobes,
narrow noses, and thin lips. Their front teeth are pointed rather than
chisel-shaped like humans, and when agitated, their thin lips often pull
back to expose these sharp points. Common underground goblins have pale
yellowish skin, while those who make their homes on the surface darken to
a deep greenish color. The smaller and ruddier Kobolds and the larger
muddier-colored Hobgoblins are closely related, and the three races are
collectively considered goblinoids.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Goblins can see 10' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Decreased Size
racial_talents.description:
Goblins are Small creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 0.75.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Goblins can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Prodigy
racial_talents.description:
Small, strong, agile hands, and an easy ability to visualize three
dimensional solids (from their history as dwellers
in caves and mines of complex layout) makes
them very adept with mechanical devices (+25 to Mechanics).

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Goblins suffer a -75 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-50 on cloudy days, -25 in shaded conditions or very cloudy days, or -0 in
full shadows such as under storm clouds or heavy tree cover.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Goblins recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

name: Gratar
description:
Gratar are frog-like humanoids, about man sized in height, and
predominantly evil. Possessing wide drooling mouths and large bulbous
eyes, these creatures are amphibians, but spend most of their time out
of the water, and even dwell underground occasionally. Female Gratar
are slightly shorter but heavier of build and are physically the equal
of the males.

racial_talents.name: Sight, Gecko
racial_talents.description:
Gratar eyes perform like those of a gecko, permitting additional detail
close-up as well as good depth vision, and they do not lose color
vision in dark conditions (normal penalties for darkness still apply).
They gain a +10 bonus to all vision-based Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Recurved Musculature
racial_talents.description:
Gratar are incredible jumpers with powerful legs. Their running long
base jump is 12 feet and their running high base jump is 29 inches
(standing base jumps are half these values). See Jumping skill in
Chapter 3 for more details about jumping. In addition, they receive
a +20 bonus to Acrobatics, Climbing, Jumping, and Running maneuvers.

name: Half-Elf
description:
The relationship between Elven and Human communities may be complicated
or even tense. When there is a shared threat, they may become close
allies, but without a unifying cause, many Elves feel the instability
and rapid turnover of Human societies is something that should be kept
at arm's length. Nonetheless, there are those among the Elves who admire
Humans' drive and passion, as well as those among the Humans who are
drawn toward Elven beauty and wisdom. The dramatic difference in their
lifespans makes lasting relationships difficult, but Half-Elven children
may be the result. Half-Elves typically live in Elven or Human societies,
rather than forming societies of their own. However, in regions where
contact between the two races has been steady over long periods of time,
mixed populations can arise and develop their own distinct cultural
identities. Such populations may consist of individuals with varying
degrees of each ancestry, some with more Human traits and some more Elven.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description:
Half Elves meditate rather than sleeping. Three hours of meditation replaces four
hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Half Elves can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

name: Halfling
description:
Halflings are very short, rarely more than 4’ in height, and tend to be
stout (trending toward fat with age). They have large, hairy feet — to
the point of being “furry” — that are almost immune to cold, and so they
often go around barefoot. They are an inoffensive people, preferring the
quiet of their own villages. Lovers of good food and drink, they spend
much of their time at inns and friends’ houses, eating and drinking.
Their settlements are usually focused around agriculture, but halfling
artisans are not uncommon and they have a knack for fine detail that
even the larger races may appreciate. Halflings are happy to trade
with other peoples and welcome guests, but do not encourage others to
settle in their villages. The small scale of their homes is enough
discouragement for most Humans. Nonetheless, they enjoy good relations
with nearby settlements that are willing to reciprocate. Most commonly
these are Human, though Halflings are usually pleased to see Gnomes
settle nearby.

racial_talents.name: Decreased Size
racial_talents.description:
Halflings are Small creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 0.75.

racial_talents.name: Prodigy
racial_talents.description: Halflings gain a +10 bonus on Stalking maneuvers.

name: Hobgoblin
description:
From time to time, Goblins birth unusual large offspring, who will grow
into much larger adults whose skin has a muddy tinge and whose feet
feel no pain. Only lack of numbers prevents the Hobgoblins from
terrorizing all lands lit by the sky. Goblins avert this dread fate by
killing most of them at birth. Those children who survive are prone to
violent, bullying behavior and a significant challenge for their parents.
By adulthood, superior size and strength offer them dominance over those
who revere the rule of brute force, and the Goblins frequently submit to
a Hobgoblin king. The brilliance of the sun, although unpleasant, holds
no horror for Hobgoblins who fearlessly follow enemies through daylight.
These clever fighters are quite formidable on the battlefield, limited
only by a lack of loyalty to each other and the cowardice of the Goblins
typically under their command. Some, however, are forced out of Goblin
communities, mainly due to failed attempts to defeat stronger kin, and
must make their way on their own or with small groups of compatriots.
They may become bandits or poorly-disciplined mercenaries, or join up with
other Goblinoids. In any situation, they are prone to seeking dominance
whenever existing leaders show apparent weakness.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Hobgoblins can see 20' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Hobgoblins can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Hobgoblins suffer a -25 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
but no penalty on cloudy days or in shady areas.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Hobgoblins recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

name: Human, cave
description:
Cave men are the isolated remnants of the ancestors of common men.
Muscular with sloping foreheads and oversized jaws, cave men have brown
hair or ginger hair and eyes, and tan skin, but are shorter than their
common kin. Simple garments made of animal skins are the normal garb.
Their intellect is not powerful, but a cooperative, good-tempered
disposition makes their company a pleasant experience. Cave men band
together to form tribes, each with its own complex set of social rituals
and religious beliefs. Their average life span is 50 years. Rough spears
or clubs are their usual weaponry. Those who came into conflict with
common men were conquered, killed, or absorbed, so those who remain
are the tribes who live in isolation.

racial_talents.name: None
racial_talents.description:
Humans are the standard against which all other races are compared.
However, humans do benefit from a high number of bonus DP (as shown
on Table 2-2a). Even the more powerful High men, despite their stature,
are essentially human.

name: Human, common
description:
Common mortal men are the same race we are familiar with in the real
world and come in the same variations of size, build, skin/hair colors
and facial features as the humans we know. Highly adaptable, they can
be found in just about any climate or environment and develop widely-varied
cultures. Skin color tends to be darker in sunny climates and lighter as
none moves towards the poles, but these shifts take millennia and
large-scale migrations and individual travel may result in notable
exceptions and mixed populations. In any case, common men have the same
stat bonuses and other traits regardless of their place of origin or
particular ancestry.

racial_talents.name: None
racial_talents.description:
Humans are the standard against which all other races are compared.
However, humans do benefit from a high number of bonus DP (as shown
on Table 2-2a). Even the more powerful High men, despite their stature,
are essentially human.

name: Human, high
description:
High men are taller and stronger than common men, more lordly in
appearance, longer lived, and tend to be more daring and ambitious.
They are also notoriously stiff and rigid, not as flexible or adaptable
as their common brethren, and more easily swayed by their own pride
or the lure of magic and power. They build great empires, but those
empires often collapse spectacularly due to their own hubris. High men
are more feared than loved, and often considered domineering. They may
have the blood of gods or giants explaining both their strength and
their pride. As with common men, they vary in coloration and other
physical traits, depending on their places of origin and other
historical factors. High men tend to build societies apart from
common men, except when they conquer them, but individual High men
may make their name among their Common kin, for example as mercenaries.

racial_talents.name: None
racial_talents.description:
Humans are the standard against which all other races are compared.
However, humans do benefit from a high number of bonus DP (as shown
on Table 2-2a). Even the more powerful High men, despite their stature,
are essentially human.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: High Humans are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Human, mixed
description:
Mixed men are the offspring of High and Common parents. They are
intermediate in features and can be difficult to distinguish from
either kin. Societies where High and Common humans have frequent contact
may have significant populations of mixed men.

racial_talents.name: None
racial_talents.description:
Humans are the standard against which all other races are compared.
However, humans do benefit from a high number of bonus DP (as shown
on Table 2-2a). Even the more powerful High men, despite their stature,
are essentially human.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Mixed Humans are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Hvasstonn
description:
Also known as giantlings or great men, Hvasstonn are similar in many
respects to extremely large humans, differing in their height
(men average 7'6"), deeply set eyes so dark a pupil can barely
be distinguished, profuse short coarse grey body hair almost thick
enough to be considered fur, and the sharp teeth of carnivores. Brown
to olive skin is not completely hidden by their body hair, while on
their heads their hair grows dark. Their features appear feral and in
a scowl of anger they bare carnivorous teeth. Although nearly as
intelligent as humans, their efforts at building are focused on survival
and warfare, for which they are well suited. To fuel their physique,
Hvasstonn rely almost exclusively on meat. They live in wooden huts or
find comfortable caves which they embellish and close off to make
comfortable if simple homes.

racial_talents.name: Increased Size
racial_talents.description:
Hvasstonn are Big creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 1.5.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Hvasstonn may attack using their sharp teeth, using the Bite specialization of
Combat Training: Unarmed skill.

racial_talents.name: Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Hvasstonn are carnivores and gain no sustenance from foods other than meat.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Hvasstonn are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 10.

name: Idiyva
description:
Short, gold-tipped coffee-colored fur covers the lithe, well-muscled
form of the Idiyva except at the face, the palms, and the soles of
the feet. Smooth, brown suedelike skin emerges at these features,
and the fur on the head lengthens and lightens to form a golden mane
around the face. Green feline eyes give the Idiyva excellent Nightvision;
fanged teeth reveal their carnivorous nature. The toes of their feet
anchor short, sharp talons, but their hands sport vicious 3" claws
that retract at the knuckle into the backs of the hands, leaving
the fingers free at all times. In addition to their natural claws,
these felines are adept in normal melee weapons and missile weapons.
Despite their animalistic appearance, their manual dexterity is as
good or better than Humans and their artisans may be just as skilled.
They also enjoy music and dance, and their retractable claws offer no
impediment to the playing of most musical instruments.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Idiyva can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Idiyva may attack using their claws, using the Claw specialization of
Combat Training: Unarmed skill.

racial_talents.name: Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Idiyva are carnivores and gain no sustenance from foods other than meat.

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Cat
racial_talents.description:
Idiyva hearing is equivalent to that of a
cat, allowing them to hear some high-pitched sounds
and more accurately determine the location of a
sound’s source (gaining +10 on Perception maneuvers to locate a sound).

name: Kobold
description:
Smallest of the goblinoid races, with ruddy skin and a pair of
horns growing from their heads, Kobolds knuckle under to the fiercer
bullying practiced by their larger kin. The compassionate wayfarer who
feels sympathy for their piteous plight discovers his mistake when
Kobold treachery rewards his generosity with capture by Goblins. The
arts of lying, cheating, stealing, and flattery enable the cowardly
Kobold to survive within bloodthirsty Goblin society; they exercise
these skills with much whimpering in all situations. In principle they
are capable of reaching a life span of 75 years, but few do. Kobolds will
rarely stand and fight in a straight up battle. They will wait for an
ambush opportunity (or at least a surprise attack), or possibly wait
for help to arrive if they cannot run away. If none of the above is
possible, surrender is always an option, as they usually have little
to lose. An oath of surrender, of course, will be quickly broken if
the tides turn.

racial_talents.name: Decreased Size
racial_talents.description:
Kobolds are Small creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 0.75.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Kobolds can see 10' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Kobolds can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Kobolds may attack using their claws, using the Claw specialization of
Combat Training: Unarmed skill, but such attacks are considered Tiny.

racial_talents.name: Lesser Attack
racial_talents.description: Your Claw attack is weak relative to your size and is decreased by size -1.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Kobolds recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Kobolds are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Kobolds suffer a -50 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-25 on cloudy days, and no penalty in shaded conditions.

name: Nycamerith
description:
Although many wonder if they are akin to Gnomes or even Halflings,
these short, fat, blue-skinned beings are most likely an entire race
unto themselves. Their ears are large and pointed and their eyes dance
to the music that they continually play. Making their way through their
long lives (up to 600 years) following The Great Song, they are a
cheerful and pleasing people, rarely getting involved in anything
violent, dangerous or risky. Nycamerith are among the greatest musicians
and musical instrument crafters in the world. They are sometimes skilled
as great craftsmen of other delicate constructions as well. Most are
content to entertain in taverns and work their craft. They dwell in
secluded villages located in deep valleys or on high mountains, but will
travel for an appreciative audience. Rarely armed, they simply do not
go into hostile or dangerous areas. When their villages are threatened
despite their remote, hidden locations, they are more likely to abandon
them than do battle.

racial_talents.name: Golden Throat
racial_talents.description:
Nycamerith have beautiful voices which soothe and calm. They receive
+10 to any maneuver to verbally calm or persuade (Charm, Singing,
Leadership, etc.).

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Cat
racial_talents.description:
Nycamerith hearing is equivalent to that of a
cat, allowing them to hear some high-pitched sounds
and more accurately determine the location of a
sound’s source (gaining +10 on Perception maneuvers to locate a sound).

racial_talents.name: Perfect Pitch
racial_talents.description:
Nycamerith have perfect pitch and are able to reproduce any pitch with
their voice or an appropriate instrument. This allows them to play most
pieces of music after hearing them. They receive +10 to any
Performance Art: Singing or Play Instrument skill. This is not cumulative
with Golden Throat.

racial_talents.name: Non-violent
racial_talents.description:
Nycamerith do not want to hurt others, and flinch with remorse when doing so.
After inflicting a critical by any means, any action they take in the following
round suffers a penalty of -40.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Nycamerith are more fragile than other humanoids. Their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Orc, greater
description:
Greater Orcs are tough and cunning, able to operate in daylight
without penalty, and often the leaders of orcish tribes.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Greater Orcs can see 15' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Greater Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Greater Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Greater Orcs are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Orc, grey
description:
Grey Orcs are highly intelligent, although they use that genius
for evil and dark things. Many are spellcasters, especially Sorcerers,
Clerics, and Magicians. They often work in small numbers with other
types of orcs. Although they are smarter than Greater Orcs, orc
society is ruled by the physically strong, and Grey Orcs are more
likely to advise than rule.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Grey Orcs can see 15' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Grey Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Grey Orcs suffer a -50 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-25 on cloudy days, and no penalty in shaded conditions.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Grey Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Fragile
racial_talents.description: Grey Orcs are exceptionally fragile their base hits are reduced by 5.

name: Orc, lesser
description:
Lesser Orcs are born to live, fight, and die in darkness; they hate
the stars and moon, but panic under the brighter sun. They make up
the bulk of the orc population.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Lesser Orcs can see 15' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Lesser Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Lesser Orcs suffer a -50 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-25 on cloudy days, and no penalty in shaded conditions.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Lesser Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

name: Orc, scrug
description: -| Scrugs are as dimwitted as Lesser Orcs, but distinguished by their great size. They are often mistaken for ogres or trolls at a distance. While most are not disposed to being chieftains, Scrugs can often be found as the bodyguards of orc chieftains, although they have no regard for any other living being, even other orcs.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Scrug Orcs can see 15' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Scrug Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Scrug Orcs suffer a -50 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-25 on cloudy days, and no penalty in shaded conditions.

racial_talents.name: Increased Size
racial_talents.description:
Scrug Orcs are Big creatures. In addition to other effects of size,
multiply their concussion hits by 1.5.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Scrug Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Greater Orcs are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 10.

name: Orc, vard
description:
Vards are a four-armed mutation of Greater Orcs but keep to their
own kind. They are rarely encountered with other breeds of orcs.
Vards are more sensitive to sunlight than Greater Orcs but less so
than the other breeds. Vards can effectively wield a shield and
three weapons, four different weapons, or a pair of two-handed weapons.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Vard Orcs can see 15' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Vard Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Vard Orcs suffer a -25 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
and no penalty on cloudy days or in shaded conditions.

racial_talents.name: Ambidextrous
racial_talents.description:
Vard Orcs are able to use any of their four hands equally well for all maneuvers
and activities. The normal -20 penalty for off-hand usage does not apply.

racial_talents.name: Additional Limb Pair
racial_talents.description:
Vard Orcs possess four arms. The additional arms may be used to manipulate
and to make attacks with the usual penalties for multiple attacks (see
Katas in Section 9.7). One arm may carry a shield (Vard Orcs cannot
effectively wield multiple shields).

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Vard Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Greater Orcs are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Plynos
description:
A regal buck’s or lithe doe’s head graces a Human’s body making this
being easily identifiable as a Plynos. The deermen are herbivorous,
but bucks in particular enjoy combat and battle if it is noble and
honorable— they do not abide cruelty or senseless violence. They
dwell in wooden cabins of their own construction and most commonly
live in family clans of six to eight individuals. They can be good
neighbors if their lands are respected, but have been known to become
hostile or xenophobic if they feel they are being encroached upon.
In regions where they are threatened, they gather in larger settlements,
but the combination of external tensions and internal rivalry for
status can make such arrangements short-lived.

racial_talents.name: Acute Smell
racial_talents.description: Plynos gain a +10 bonus on Perception rolls involving smell.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Many male Plynos have antlers powerful enough to attack with, using
the horn specialization of Combat Training: Unarmed skill. This is not
included in the racial total, but may be purchased for 5 DP.

racial_talents.name: Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Plynos are herbivores and cannot digest meat.

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Cat
racial_talents.description:
Plynos hearing is equivalent to that of a
cat, allowing them to hear some high-pitched sounds
and more accurately determine the location of a
sound’s source (gaining +10 on Perception maneuvers to locate a sound).

name: Sea-kral
description:
Sea-krals are ape-like creatures with dark grey or blue skin and a
pelt of thick, white hair growing on their head, neck, and shoulders.
Females possess an additional thicket that grows down the bony spine
of their backs. Both genders have long arms and an extra bone connecting
the wrist to the hand. Long, dexterous fingers capped by a claw-like
nail aid them in becoming accomplished craftsmen and bowmen.
Although somewhat smaller than humans, they are strong for their size.
Sea-krals fear the hungry waves, but derive too much pleasure from
their violent way of life to abandon the ocean. They build longships in
which to ply the seas, raiding and plundering other vessels as pirates.
Their boats serve as their only home in spite of the fact that most
cannot swim. They sleep during the day and are active during the night.
Leather scale armor and curved swords are their usual battle garb.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Sea-krals can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Extra Joints
racial_talents.description:
Sea-kral arms are multiply-jointed and agile. All physical maneuvers that depend
primarily on their arms, including melee, throwing, and climbing, gain a +10 bonus.

racial_talents.name: Inept
racial_talents.description:
Sea-kral are poorly suited for swimming and suffer a -10 to all swimming
maneuvers. Their extra joints offer no advantage here.

name: Sibbicai
description:
Most likely distant kin of the more bestial Vulfen, the Sibbicai
have a jackal’s head and smooth, oily black, shorthaired coats covering
their muscular humanoid bodies. Their hair is long only on their heads,
like that of a human, and they usually wear it either up in a crest,
or long, down their backs. An intelligent and cultured people, Sibbicai
fit in well with other mannish races, assuming the other races have no
prejudices. However, they often feel a quiet rivalry towards Idiyva
and a distaste for the disorder of Vulfen and goblinoids.

racial_talents.name: Acute Smell
racial_talents.description: Sibbicai gain a +15 bonus on Perception rolls involving smell.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
Hearing, Dog
racial_talents.description:
Sibbicai have hearing as sensitive as a dog, allowing them to
pinpoint nearby sounds with high accuracy and hear sounds up
to 4 times as far away as a human, including very high-pitched
sounds. This grants +10 on sound-based Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Prodigy
racial_talents.description:
Sibbicai have a natural talent
for tracking, in part due to their keen sense of smell.
They receive a +10 bonus on Tracking maneuvers.

name: Sohleugir
description:
Textured jade scales shimmer on the hide of the amphibious Sohleugir,
interrupted by fin-like ridges rising along the spine. These jagged
spikes march from the tip of the three-foot tail to the crown of the
draconic, snouted head. A transparent extra lid covers the eyes
underwater or against dust in the air. The digits of their hands and
feet bear translucent, claw-like nails. Sohleugir scales have been
used to make very fine armor—of course, no wise armorer would admit
that he works such feats, lest news reach these violent folk.

racial_talents.name: Natural Armor
racial_talents.description:
Sohleugir’s scales provide the
protection of armor type (AT) 4 against attacks
without any encumbrance or maneuver penalties.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
Sight, Gecko
racial_talents.description:
Sohleugir eyes perform like those of a gecko, permitting additional
detail close-up as well as good depth vision and they do not
lose color vision in dark conditions (normal penalties for
darkness still apply). They gain a +10 bonus to all
vision-based Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Tetrachromatic Vision
racial_talents.description:
Sohleugir vision encompasses normal color vision as well as
sensitivity to ultraviolet light. Their sense of colors differs
from other races, and they are more sensitive to cues others
cannot see. Penalties for spotting invisible
(including hidden by the Unseen spell) and camouflaged people
and objects are reduced by 30.

racial_talents.name: Third Eyelid
racial_talents.description:
Sohleugir eyes have a transparent
additional eyelid, or nictating membrane, which
protects them while still permitting sight. They are
unaffected by dust, sand, or water which otherwise
might limit use of their eyes.

name: Sstoi'isslythi
description:
Slim men who move with the coiling grace of serpents, Sstoi’isslythi
possess soft reptilian skins comprised of small golden scales. Hair,
a mammalian feature, remains conspicuously absent from their smooth
bodies. Venom sacs, located at the neck, supply the fleshy fangs
folded in their mouths with poison when danger arrives to stiffen
these organs in preparation for the strike. Sstoi’isslythi live in
family groups, each member of which is immunized to their relatives’
venom. Relations between families are surrounded by ritualized courtesy
to minimize any hostility, since the strike reflex, once aroused,
is impossible to quell. Dependent upon the environment for warmth, the
Sstoi’isslythi inhabit sunny climes that never experience the chill
of winter. Wide terraces for relaxation in the heat and skylights to
warm interior spaces with the sun’s rays dominate their elegant cities.

racial_talents.name: Heatsense
racial_talents.description:
Sstoi’isslythi have very sensitive pit
organs on their faces which allow them to gauge
temperature at close range up to 1/1000th of a degree.
This permits them to sense prey nearby or detect tracks
of prey within several hours of its passing. This grants
a bonus up to +20 on Perception and Tracking maneuvers
to detect living creatures or other warm or cold objects,
as long as the Sstoi’isslythi comes within close proximity to
them or their tracks.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Sstoi’isslythi may attack with their fangs, using the bite specialization
of Combat Training: Unarmed skill. Attacks are resolved
on the Stinger table.

racial_talents.name: Poison Injection
racial_talents.description:
The bite of a Sstoi’isslythi injects poison. If the attack scores a
critical (any severity), the target must make a Physical RR against
the Sstoi’isslythi’s level or suffer the effect of a muscle poison
(see Section 15.6 for details).

racial_talents.name: Strike Reflex
racial_talents.description:
A powerful strike reflex allows the
Sstoi’isslythi to act with tremendous speed, gaining a +20 initiative
modifier, when the reflex is triggered by any sudden movement towards
or away from them by a target within range of their attack. This
instinctive response is impossible to quell, even if they want to;
the Sstoi’isslythi must take immediate offensive action in the round
in which they are startled, rather than waiting to see what is happening.

racial_talents.name: Slow Healer
racial_talents.description: Sstoi’isslythi recover slower than normal. Recovery times are doubled.

name: Troll
description:
Trolls are large and immensely strong (usually about 9' tall and
massively built), but mentally slow compared to most other races.
Trolls are covered in a thick, hard skin that overlaps at the joints,
similar to the hide of a rhinoceros. They have hands capable of fine
manipulation, but their fingertips end in slightly curved claws,
and their teeth are obviously the ripping and tearing tools of a carnivore.

racial_talents.name: Darkvision
racial_talents.description: Trolls can see 10' with no penalties even in complete darkness.

racial_talents.name: Inept
racial_talents.description:
Trolls by nature and reputation are
violent and dangerous. They suffer a -25 penalty on any
attempt to use Influence skills, except to provoke a fear or
morale reaction.

racial_talents.name: Increased Size
racial_talents.description:
Trolls are Big creatures. In addition to other effects of size, multiply
their concussion hits by 1.5.

racial_talents.name: Light Sensitivity
racial_talents.description:
Trolls suffer a -50 penalty when in bright light equal to direct sunlight,
-25 on cloudy days, and no penalty in shaded conditions.

racial_talents.name: Natural Armor
racial_talents.description:
The tough hide of a troll provides the
protection of armor type (AT) 4 against attacks
without any encumbrance or maneuver penalties.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description:
Trolls may attack with their claw, using the bite specialization
of Combat Training: Unarmed skill. Attacks are resolved
on the Stinger table.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Trolls can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as
a human can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40,
except in pitch dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Elemental Resistance
racial_talents.description:
Trolls are very hardy and gain a +15 DB,
RR, and Endurance bonus against cold and ice.
If the effect is a fixed critical and none of these modifiers
apply, the severity of Cold criticals is reduced by
one. These modifiers also apply to extreme environmental
conditions such as traveling in arctic conditions.

racial_talents.name: Elemental Resistance
racial_talents.description:
Trolls are very hardy and gain a +15 DB,
RR, and Endurance bonus against heat, and fire.
If the effect is a fixed critical and none of these modifiers
apply, the severity of Heat criticals is reduced by
one. These modifiers also apply to extreme environmental
conditions such as traveling in an extremely hot desert conditions.

name: Vulfen
description:
Furred men with wolfish heads and tails, Vulfen are often confused
with werewolves. Such is the fear and loathing with which Vulfen
are generally regarded that this usually winds up being worse for
the Werewolves. Cunning intelligence shapes the behavior of Vulfen,
but cruelty and bloodthirst deprive them of Mannish respect and
liking. Vulfen run in packs, killing and devouring all in their
path until exhaustion and sated hunger compel them to rest for a
few days. They are nocturnal, sleeping by day and rampaging by night.
Their lives are brutal but usually short, rarely beyond 40 years.
Their own armament of fangs and claws is often supplemented by
weapons garnered from fallen foes.

racial_talents.name: Acute Smell
racial_talents.description: Vulfen gain a +10 bonus on Perception rolls involving smell.

racial_talents.name: Hearing, Dog
racial_talents.description:
Vulfen have hearing as sensitive as a dog, allowing them to
pinpoint nearby sounds with high accuracy and hear sounds
up to 4 times as far away as a human, including very
high-pitched sounds. This grants +10 on sound based
Perception maneuvers.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Vulfen are carnivores and gain no sustenance from foods other than meat.

racial_talents.name: Frenzy
racial_talents.description:
Vulfen can enter a frenzied rage with a successful Adrenal Focus
maneuver. While frenzied, they gain a +5 Strength Bonus.

racial_talents.name: Tough
racial_talents.description: Vulfen are exceptionally tough and pain resistant. Their base hits are increased by 5.

name: Half-Orc (A)
description:
In some settings, orcs and humans may occasionally interbreed, resulting in half-orcs. They are almost as hardy as orcs, but not so dimwitted.

This race is from the example in Core-Law p.249.

racial_talents.name: Nightvision
racial_talents.description:
Half Orcs can see in dim light, equivalent to nighttime conditions, as well as a human
can see in daylight. All penalties for darkness are reduced by 40, except in pitch
dark conditions.

racial_talents.name: Fast Healer
racial_talents.description: Half Orcs recover faster than normal. Recovery times are halved.

name: Dyari (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Ascended.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description: Elves meditate rather than sleep, and two hours of meditation replaces four hours of sleep.

name: Erlini (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Hunter. Sylvan could also be appropriate for less martial settlements.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description: Elves meditate rather than sleep, and two hours of meditation replaces four hours of sleep.

name: Linæri (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Ascended.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description: Elves meditate rather than sleep, and two hours of meditation replaces four hours of sleep.

name: Loari (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Ascended.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description: Elves meditate rather than sleep, and two hours of meditation replaces four hours of sleep.

name: Eritari (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Half-Elves are very diverse. Choose an appropriate culture based on their upbringing. In many cases this will be the culture of a parent.

name: Kytaari (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Half-Elves are very diverse. Choose an appropriate culture based on their upbringing. In many cases this will be the culture of a parent.

description: Typical Culture: Half-Elves are very diverse. Choose an appropriate culture based on their upbringing. In many cases this will be the culture of a parent.

name: Sulini (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Half-Elves are very diverse. Choose an appropriate culture based on their upbringing. In many cases this will be the culture of a parent.

name: Vorloi (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Half-Elves are very diverse. Choose an appropriate culture based on their upbringing. In many cases this will be the culture of a parent.

description:
Typical Culture: Underground.

or flaws.

name: Anzeti (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Harsh.

name: Haid (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Hunter, or Reaver for more warlike tribes.

name: Jaaderi (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Proud, Rural, or Urban. Noble and Sanctified are also appropriate for the upper castes of the Lankan Empire.

name: Jineri (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Coastal, Mariner, Rural, or Urban.

name: Laan (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Highland, Mariner, Noble, Proud, Rural, or Urban.

name: Lydians (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background.

name: Ochu (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background.

name: Shay (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Highland, Mariner, Rural, or Urban.

name: Talath (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Proud, Rural.

name: Thesians (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background.

name: Umli (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Harsh.

name: Y'nari (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Highland.

name: Dúranaki (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Underground.

name: Kinsai (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Nomad.

name: Ilourians (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background. The T’loc-Loc have a Hunter culture.

name: Jameri (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Rural, Urban.

name: Muadani (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character's background.

name: Rhiani (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Nomad.

name: Syrkakar (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background.

name: Y'kin (SW)
description: Typical Culture: Highland, Rural, Urban.

name: Shuluri
description: Typical Culture: Oceanic. Mariner or Ascended could also be appropriate for those living on land.

racial_talents.name: Efficient Sleeper
racial_talents.description: Elves meditate rather than sleep, and two hours of meditation replaces four hours of sleep.

racial_talents.name: Swimming
racial_talents.description: Shuluri have a base movement rate of 20’ in water, with a maximum pace of Jog.

racial_talents.name: Air and Water Breathing
racial_talents.description: The Shuluri may breathe water or air without difficulty.

name: Jhordi
description: Typical Culture: Ascended.

racial_talents.name: Innate Spell List
racial_talents.description: All Jhordi know the Mind Speech spell list (Mentalist base) to level 10. Spells are cast as described in Spell Law section 4.8, including a spell casting roll and chance of spell failure. Innate spell-lists are treated as Base lists for SCR.

name: Goblin (Murlogi)
description: Typical Culture: Skulker. Underground could also be appropriate.

racial_talents.name: Prodigy
racial_talents.description: +25 to Mechanics skill.

name: Gark
description: Typical Culture: Skulker. Snow Garks might use Harsh. Jungle and Cliff Garks could also use Hunter.

racial_talents.name: Prehensile Appendage
racial_talents.description: Gark tails are dexterous enough to hold and grasp objects.

name: Lugroki, Greater
description: Typical Culture: Dark.

name: Synshari
description: Typical Culture: Harsh.

racial_talents.name: Cold Sensitive
racial_talents.description: Synshari are sluggish in cold weather and suffer a penalty to all actions of -1 per degree below 70°F.

racial_talents.name: Natural Armor
racial_talents.description: The leathery skin of the Synshari provides them with AT 3.

name: Hirazi
description: Typical Culture: Aerial.

racial_talents.name: Wings, Flying
racial_talents.description: Hirazi have a base movement rate of 60’/rnd while flying. They can reach a Run pace in level flight or Sprint while diving.

racial_talents.name: Light-boned
racial_talents.description: Hirazi are treated as Small creatures for purposes of their hits (determine their hits normally, then multiply by 0.75) and as the targets of attacks. However, they are treated as Medium creatures for attacks they make.

name: Lugroki, Lesser
description: Typical Culture: Skulker.

name: Trogli
description: Typical Culture: Dark

racial_talents.name: Phobia
racial_talents.description: Trogli are terrified of daylight. Being exposed to daylight requires a fear RR, taking the effects as shown in RMU Core Law on Table 14-3a. Any surrender result indicates paralysis for one round per 10 failure. If you must interact with daylight directly, treat it as 10th level fear attack. If you will be surrounded by daylight, treat it as 20th level. If they do manage to control their fear, they do not suffer any penalties on their actions.

name: Quaidu
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background.

name: Kuluku
description: Typical Culture: Sylvan.

name: Centaur
description:
Typical Culture: Sylvan.

Due to their numerous advantages, Centaurs have a high point cost and as a result have a negative number of racial bonus DP. This results in a DP deficit which must be paid off, and due to the magnitude it will be necessary to do so over multiple levels. An adult Centaur will not be a 1st level character. For very low level Centaurs, it may be appropriate to treat them as juveniles, one size smaller than adults, with lower stat bonuses. Starting off as a Medium creature and reducing Co, Em, Me, Pr, Re, SD, and St bonuses by 1 each will result in a net +3 racial bonus DP rather than a negative value. These reduced bonuses must then be paid off as the Centaur grows into adulthood.

racial_talents.name: Lesser Attack
racial_talents.description: Although Centaurs are Big creatures, any attacks using their arms (e.g., wielding weapons) are merely Medium.

racial_talents.name: Restricted Diet
racial_talents.description: Centaurs are strictly herbivores.

racial_talents.name: Additional Limb Pair
racial_talents.description: Centaurs have two arms and four legs.

racial_talents.name: Walking, Quadrupedal
racial_talents.description: As quadrupeds, Centaurs have a base movement rate (BMR) of 30’/round, with a maximum pace of Dash, and gain a +10 bonus to their Running skill. (Note that Centaurs also have a +5 stride bonus, so their actual BMR before modification for their Quickness bonus is 35’/round.)

name: Droloi
description: Typical Culture: Little information is provided regarding the cultural practices of the Droloi, except that they tend to live in small groups, at least sometimes underground. Underground, Hunter, or Dark may be appropriate depending on their nature.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description: Droloi may make unarmed Claw attacks.

racial_talents.name: Disturbing Form
racial_talents.description: Other races find the Droloi’s appearance to be extremely disturbing. This gives a penalty of -20 to any maneuver to calm or persuade, if the Droloi is visible.

racial_talents.name: Natural Armor
racial_talents.description: Droloi have a natural AT of 2.

name: Saurkur
description: Typical Culture: Sylvan for those living in and working the jungles, Mariner for fishermen and others working the coast, Rural for those engaged in agriculture, and Urban for those living in the larger cities.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description: Saurkur may make unarmed attacks using their claws.

racial_talents.name: Natural Armor
racial_talents.description: Saurkur scales provide them with natural AT 4.

name: Krylites
description: Typical Culture: Skulker

racial_talents.name: Poison Injection
racial_talents.description: Krylite defenders produce a reduction venom which is delivered upon a successful tongue attack (i.e., an attack which inflicts a critical).

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description: Krylite defenders have powerful pincers which they use in melee, attacking on the Beak table.

racial_talents.name: Natural Weaponry
racial_talents.description: In addition to their pincers, Krylites have an eversible tongue appendage capable of making Stinger attacks.

name: Zjedrahir
description: Typical Culture: Variable, select based on the character’s background. Proud might be appropriate.

name: Rasha-ai
description: Typical Culture: Rural.

name: Dwarf (Nomari)
description: Typical Culture: Underground.

racial_talents.name: Inept
racial_talents.description: Due to their density, dwarves must work especially hard to keep from drowning. They suffer a -25 penalty on Endurance rolls while swimming.

name: Mermen
description: Typical Culture: Oceanic.

racial_talents.name: Swimming
racial_talents.description: Mermen move easily through water, with a base movement rate of 30’/round and a maximum pace of Run.

racial_talents.name: Air and Water Breathing
racial_talents.description: Mermen can breathe water or air without difficulty.

racial_talents.name: Amphibious
racial_talents.description: Mermen require regular immersion in water. After a day out of water, they suffer a penalty on all actions of -1 per hour they have spent out of water. This penalty may only be removed by immersion in water.

racial_talents.name: Awkward Movement
racial_talents.description: It’s possible for a Merman to move on land, but they are awkward and slow. Their base movement rate on land is halved with a maximum pace of Run, and they have a -15 penalty on Running skill. A Merman capable of transforming their tail into legs does not suffer these penalties while they have legs; this may be purchased as an 8 DP talent, requiring 1 minute to transform and lasting for 4 hours plus 1 hour per level.
